containerDefinitions.name: infinityai-engine-c
command: echo 'server { listen 8003; location /health { return 200 "healthy"; add_header Content-Type text/plain; } location /trade { return 200 "Trading Engine Active"; add_header Content-Type text/plain; } location / { return 200 "Engine C - Trade Execution Running on Port 8003"; add_header Content-Type text/plain; } }' > /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf && nginx -g 'daemon off;'
